title: Incorrect value will get sent to the commLayer
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `factory.createERC20DAO()` function creates cross-chain DAOs using LayerZero. Users can specify msg.value, which is distributed across multiple chains. For example, if there are 5 chains and msg.value is 1000, each chain receives 200. This value is forwarded to the commLayer.  The \_depositChainIds array is intended to manage the distribution across chains.
